text_blocks.snippet: Pancreatic cancer and kidney failure can be linked through several mechanisms. Pancreatic cancer can directly cause kidney problems or kidney failure through metastasis or paraneoplastic syndromes. Additionally, treatment for pancreatic cancer, such as chemotherapy, can have nephrotoxic effects, potentially leading to kidney damage or failure. Conversely, pre-existing kidney conditions, like chronic kidney disease (CKD), can impact the progression and treatment of pancreatic cancer.
